title: Improved Gradient Descent Lower Bounds Beyond Nesterov
abstract: arXiv:2609.02855v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study how far gradient descent (GD) can be accelerated by predetermined stepsizes in smooth convex optimization. Going beyond the classical $\Omega(n^{-2})$ first-order oracle lower bound of Nemirovsky and Yudin, we prove an $\Omega(n^{-1.6342})$ non-anytime lower bound and an $\Omega(n^{-1.2408})$ anytime lower bound. These improve the recent $\Omega(n^{-1.932})$ non-anytime lower bound of Ma and Chen and the $\Omega(n^{-4/3})$ anytime lower bound of Tsai et al., respectively. Together with the non-anytime $O(n^{-\log_2(1+\sqrt{2})})$ rate achieved by silver schedules, our anytime lower bound establishes a strict separation between the achievable convergence exponents in the two settings.

translated_title: 超越Nesterov的改进梯度下降下界
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在光滑凸优化中，梯度下降（GD）通过预先设定的步长能够被加速到何种程度。在超越Nemirovsky和Yudin经典的Ω(n^{-2})一阶oracle下界的基础上，我们证明了Ω(n^{-1.6342})的非anytime下界以及Ω(n^{-1.2408})的anytime下界。这两个结果分别改进了Ma和Chen近期提出的Ω(n^{-1.932})非anytime下界，以及Tsai等人提出的Ω(n^{-4/3}) anytime下界。结合silver步长调度所达到的非anytime O(n^{-log_2(1+√2)})收敛速率，我们的anytime下界在这两种设定下可实现的收敛指数之间建立了严格的分离。
tldr: 本文证明了光滑凸优化中固定步长梯度下降的两个更强下界——非anytime的Ω(n^{-1.6342})与anytime的Ω(n^{-1.2408})，并借助silver调度可达的O(n^{-log_2(1+√2)})速率，严格分离了两种设定下可实现的收敛指数。
en_tdlr: This paper proves stronger lower bounds for gradient descent with predetermined stepsizes—Ω(n^{-1.6342}) non-anytime and Ω(n^{-1.2408}) anytime—which, together with the O(n^{-log_2(1+√2)}) rate achieved by silver schedules, establishes a strict separation between the achievable convergence exponents in the two settings.
